fresh_imports.command:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src:../orze-pro/src CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= python3 - <<'PY'
import json,os,select,signal,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();modules=['orze.core.gpu_lease','orze.hardware.gpu','orze.reporting.state','orze.cli','orze.core.execution_attempts','orze.engine.controller_control','orze.engine.controller_members','orze.engine.supervised_process','orze.engine.execution_authority','orze.engine.role_supervision','orze.engine.gpu_slots','orze.idea_lake','orze.core.controller_profile','orze.engine.controller_session','orze.engine.lifecycle']
program="from unittest.mock import patch; patch('orze_pro._gate.require_license').start(); import importlib,sys; from pathlib import Path; module=importlib.import_module(sys.argv[1]); assert Path(module.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve())"
env={**os.environ,'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE':'1','CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES':'','PYTHONPATH':str(root/'src')+os.pathsep+str(root.parent/'orze-pro'/'src')}
results=[]
for name in modules:
    child=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-c',program,name,str(root/'src')],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,env=env)
    descriptor=os.pidfd_open(child.pid)
    try:
        stdout,stderr=child.communicate(timeout=15)
        assert child.returncode==0,(name,child.returncode,stderr[-3000:])
        results.append({'module':name,'exit_code':child.returncode})
    finally:
        if not select.select([descriptor],[],[],0)[0]:
            signal.pidfd_send_signal(descriptor,signal.SIGKILL)
            child.wait(timeout=5)
        os.close(descriptor)
print(json.dumps({'fresh_exec_public_imports':results,'count':len(results),'source_bound':True,'license':'explicit test-only gate patch','no_gpu_processes':True}))
PY
